# Time series {#sec-time-series}

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| echo: false

library(rebook)
chapterPreamble()
```

Microbial communities are dynamic, constantly evolving over time. However,
despite temporal fluctuations driven by environmental and other factors, the
microbiome retains its core characteristics [@Schmidt2018].

Compared to cross-sectional studies, a longitudinal study design allows
researchers to follow changes within the same individuals. Analyzing such data
includes aspects that need to be taken into account, such as the dependence
between samples collected from the same subject.

Most of the methods introduced earlier in this book can be applied to
longitudinal data with small modifications. For more details, see the
following chapters:

- [@sec-time-diversity]
